exposure: postpartum nurse navigator (PPNN) text messaging intervention
cohort: The study included 43 primiparous women who experienced an unplanned cesarean birth.
finding: The text messaging intervention by a postpartum nurse navigator showed high participant satisfaction, with 93% rating their overall experience as outstanding or good.
mod_finding: The high satisfaction with the text messaging intervention was observed among primiparous women who experienced an unplanned cesarean birth.
